title: ChipBlocks memory backends manifest
description: Single source of truth for memory backend configurations. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Each row conforms to a versioned memory socket (chipblocks-memory-socket-vN) so the system can wire memory generically. Phase 0 is an empty array; first row (ice40-bram-4kb) lands in Sprint 26 alongside the bus protocol work — making the existing RAM block's iCE40-BRAM-flavored implementation explicit + pluggable.

kind.description: Memory backend category. on-chip-bram = FPGA block RAM; on-chip-sram = ASIC SRAM macro; register-file = LUT-based small storage; external-* = off-chip parts driven by our controller.

read_latency_cycles.description: Cycles from address-valid to data-out-valid. 0 = combinational read; 1 = registered read (typical BRAM); 2+ = pipelined / external.

pdk_compatible.description: List of PDK ids (from pdks.yaml) this memory backend works with. On-chip-sram entries are PDK-specific.

controller_path.description: Path to the memory-controller Elaboratable wrapper.
